parole.significato: stove, cooker; a kitchen appliance used for heating and cooking food, usually with a cooktop and an oven
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch komfoor (“warming or cooking apparatus”), ultimately from Old French Old French chaufoire (“warming room, heating apparatus”). The French word belongs to the family of chaufer (“to heat”), from Vulgar Latin Vulgar Latin *calfāre (“to heat”), from Latin calefacere (“to make warm”)
